name: Trail of Mystery
oracle_text:
Whenever a face-down creature you control enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, if it's a creature, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a face-down creature you control enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, if it's a creature, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a permanent is turned face up (morph/megamorph/disguise unmorph, manifest/cloak turned up), filterable by controller, binding the turned-up permanent as subject so an intervening 'if it's a creature' check and a pump on it can follow
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has permanent_enters, becomes_tapped, mutates, becomes_monstrous etc. but nothing for turning face up; turning a permanent face up is not an enters event, so permanent_enters cannot stand in

needs.what: a trigger/selector filter key matching face-down permanents (e.g. `face_down: true`) so permanent_enters can be narrowed to 'a face-down creature you control enters'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: face_down exists only as an op option on look_at_top/search ops (putting a card face down); trigger_filter_keys and selector_keys have no face-down predicate, and filtering on types: [Creature] alone would also fire for every face-up creature
